recommendation_summary: Set up one hosted heartbeat monitor that the Python script pings after a successful sync and that alerts the user if no ping arrives by the normal completion time plus a grace period, keeping cron and the existing summary email unchanged.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker; neither is needed to detect a missing nightly run.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends its own email, so a startup crash also silences the notification.
labels.Checked myself: Only your supplied facts: cron runs at 03:00 on `edna`, four startup failures produced no email, and no independent alert exists.

note: The reply recommends a single external dead-man heartbeat, explicitly drops central logging and Docker, and grounds its check line only in the facts it was given.
